exposure: use of the Alexis(®) O C-Section Retractor
use of the traditional Collins self-retaining metal retractor
outcome: Short and long-term satisfaction with wound healing
cohort: 98 patients in the Alexis group and 100 patients in the Collins group, all undergoing their first planned cesarean section at Charité University Hospital, Berlin between October 2013 and December 2015.
finding: The use of the Alexis O C-Section Retractor for wound retraction during cesarean section was associated with a significantly reduced risk of surgical site infection compared to the traditional Collins metal self-retaining wound retractor.
mod_finding: The study found that the use of plastic-sheath wound retractors compared to traditional self-retaining metal retractors during cesarean sections in low-risk women having their first cesarean section was associated with a significantly reduced risk of surgical site infection.
